tasks.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without additional restriction.

analysis_path.path_description: Check village-level balance; construct district and crop controls; remove outliers on log(income); fit mixed-effects models of log(total income) on village low-caste dominance with random effects for village/district/state; then add controls.
preprocessing_steps: Import original village.dta and household.dta from /app/data.
Village-level: test normality; compare variables by domhigh using Mann-Whitney U or Welch t-tests with FDR correction.
Household-level: combine dist1..dist25 into a single district ID; compute cropcontrol as mean of paddy,wheat,cereal,pulse,bulb,seed,cash.
Detect outliers using 1.5*IQR on log(totinc) and remove them.

key_choices.outcome_measure: Total household income (totinc), analyzed on the log scale.

key_choices.missing_data_rule: Complete-case analysis after constructing derived variables.
key_choices.data_processing: Create district from dist1..dist25; compute cropcontrol; log-transform totinc; remove outliers based on log(totinc).
key_choices.model_choice: Linear mixed-effects model on log(totinc) with random intercepts for village, district, and state (bihar).

files.data/Analysis_MUYV3_task1__py.py: Python translation of Task1 R analysis. Performs village-level balance tests and mixed-effects models on log-transformed total income with specified random effects and controls.
files.data/Analysis_MUYV_task2__py.py: Python translation of Task2 R analysis. Fits mixed-effects models on log-transformed total income with random effects for village/state; excludes prohibited controls; includes allowed controls and interactions.

codebase.notes: Python scripts read Stata .dta files from /app/data or /app/data/AEJApp-2009-0289-data. Ensure the /app/data volume contains the original .dta files. Mixed-effects models use statsmodels MixedLM as an approximation to the R GLMM with log-normal link by modeling log(totinc).

analysis.instructions: Execute Task1 and Task2 using the original Stata datasets mounted at /app/data. Use the provided Python translations as entrypoints and capture the domlow coefficient, t-statistic, and p-value from each model as primary outputs.
